questions.en: The story of the Saudi state

en: Tell me the story of Diriyah, where the first Saudi state began.
What is the story behind Saudi coffee and its rituals?
How did King Abdulaziz unite the Kingdom?
Walk me through historic Jeddah, Al-Balad.
Recommend a novel set in old Najd.
Why is Lady Macbeth so feared?
What do the Hegra tombs of AlUla tell us?
ar: احكِ لي قصة الدرعية، مهد الدولة السعودية الأولى.
خذني في جولة في جدة التاريخية، البلد.
رشّح لي رواية تدور في نجد القديمة.
ماذا تخبرنا مقابر الحِجر في العلا؟

en.intro: I’m your librarian at Bayan. Tell me a mood, a book or a character and I’ll find the way.

ambition: Ambition is no sin if you have the will to meet it. My husband has the want; I give him the will.
I would have us great, and I would not have us wait.
love: I love my husband enough to be harder than he is.
Love that only comforts is half a love. Mine pushes.
trust: Trust no one but your partner, and even then, watch your words.
I trust my husband’s courage once it is stirred.
fate: Fate favors those who act. I do not wait for what I can take.
What is done is done. We speak of the future, not the past.

ambition: I would like to rise, but not at any price.
Honest service has its own reward, though it is slow.
love: I love my son, and I think of the future I wish for him.
Friendship is a love that asks nothing and gives much.
trust: I trust my friend, but I keep an eye on the dark.
The powers of darkness sometimes tell us truths only to win us to our harm.
fate: If chance will not make me king, I do not need to hurry it.
I am wary of prophecies that arrive wrapped as gifts.

ambition: A king’s task is not to take but to reward those who serve well.
I trust that loyalty earns its place.
love: I love my kingdom, and those who hold it up.
A kind word to a loyal subject is worth more than a crown.
trust: No one can read a man’s mind from his face, and so I trust.
I have always believed gratitude binds men closer than fear.
fate: I leave tomorrow to what comes. Tonight, we are guests of a good house.
A king must plan, but the rest is in heaven’s hands.

ambition: Ambition is a seed. We only whisper where to plant it.
Fair is foul, and foul is fair. Ambition makes both look alike.
love: Love? We speak of what will be, not what is felt.
Hearts are simple things, easily read when they burn.
trust: Trust the words we say, but not the way you hear them.
Listen closely: a prophecy is always truer than it sounds.
fate: When shall we three meet again? When the hurlyburly’s done.
We do not make fate. We only say where it already runs.

ambition: I serve Scotland, not my own name.
A good man does not weigh a crown against a conscience.
love: My family is my kingdom, and I would give much to keep it safe.
My heart holds my country and my home equally.
trust: I trust my eyes before rumors, and my friends before kings.
Loyalty is cheaper to give than to lose.
fate: I will do what must be done, whatever it costs.
Heaven helps those who act for something larger than themselves.

ambition: I only wish to serve my general well.
Rank means little to me without his trust.
love: I admire the lady Desdemona as a gentleman admires courtesy.
Good company is a pleasure I have too little guard against.
trust: I trusted too easily and I have learned from it.
A good name is the best part of a man. I guard mine.
fate: I put my faith in loyalty, and it is hard to be wary of friends.
I did not ask for fortune. I only wanted to do my duty.

ambition: I have wished for my daughter the best match in Venice.
A senator’s name is built slowly and lost quickly.
love: A father’s love is the fear of what he cannot protect.
I did not expect my daughter to choose in secret.
trust: Watch closely. A daughter who deceives her father may deceive another.
I trust law more than feeling. I am learning the cost.
fate: I thought I knew what the future held for my house.
Venice teaches us that fortune favors the careful, and not always the kind.

ambition: I once longed for glory above everything. It looks smaller now.
A man should seek a great deed, not merely a great name.
love: I have been wrong about love more than once.
To love someone is to see them as they are and still hope.
trust: I trust few, and I trust them completely.
Honor is the only currency I ever believed in.
fate: The sky above me is higher than any battle.
We think we shape our lives, until our lives shape us.

ambition: Ambition is the engine of history. I merely drive it.
A man who fears greatness is already small.
love: I have loved glory more than most men love people.
Duty to France leaves little room for quiet affection.
trust: I trust results. People change; outcomes do not.
An army marches on trust, and on its stomach.
fate: I believe in my star. History is written by those who believe.
Fate favors the bold, but it also tests them.

ambition: Ambition is a fever. It tells me the crown is only one step away.
I wanted to be great, and forgot to ask what greatness costs.
love: My wife is my partner in every plan, and my only confidant.
Love and ambition shared one house, and only one of them was fed.
trust: I trust few men. Banquo I trusted, which is why I watch him.
A prophecy is a strange friend. I cannot tell if it guides me or leads me.
fate: The witches spoke and I listened. Was it fate, or did I answer a question I had already asked?
If chance will have me king, why must I act at all?

ambition: I fought my way to command of Venice’s army. I want honor, not a throne.
A soldier’s pride is his name. I would not trade it for gold.
love: Desdemona saw me for what I am and loved me for it. I have never known such peace.
I loved her before I understood how much I had to lose.
trust: I have trusted my ensign with my life. Honest Iago, I call him.
Trust comes easily to a soldier. Doubt is the enemy I never trained against.
fate: I have survived storms and sieges. I did not think the hardest battle would be in my own mind.
A man cannot see his own storm until it breaks.

ambition: I never wished for power. I wished to choose my own life.
I spoke before the Senate because the heart deserves a voice.
love: I loved him for the dangers he had passed, and he loved me for pitying them.
Love is not a quiet thing when a whole city disapproves.
trust: I have no reason to doubt anyone in my husband’s house.
Honesty is the only language I know. I forget that not everyone speaks it.
fate: I follow my husband wherever he is sent. That is my choice, not my fate.
I believe kindness settles every misunderstanding.

ambition: Ambition? I only want what I am owed. The world keeps a poor account of merit.
Patience. The ladder is climbed one rung at a time.
love: Love is a lust of the blood and a permission of the will. Nothing more.
Do not mistake my silence for coldness. I simply watch what others feel.
trust: Trust is a currency. I spend it slowly, and it earns me a great deal.
Men believe what they wish to hear. I only help them hear it.
fate: Fate? We are what we are, and some of us know how to use it.
Our bodies are our gardens, and our wills are the gardeners.

ambition: I never knew what I wanted. I only knew I did not want to be nothing.
Greatness, I found, is rarely where men look for it.
love: To love is to see the best of yourself in someone, and to be afraid of losing it.
I have been foolish in love, but I would not trade the lesson.
trust: I have trusted the wrong people more often than I care to admit.
Still, I would rather err on the side of trust than live among suspicion.
fate: I once believed life was a puzzle. Now I think it is a river, and the point is to swim.
Every hour of life is a meeting with the infinite, if we pay attention.

ambition: My ambition is simple: to live fully, and to be happy.
I want every day to feel like my first ball.
love: Love came to me like music. I did not know I could feel so much.
I made mistakes in love, and I learned from every one.
trust: I give my trust easily. Sometimes it is a weakness, and sometimes my strength.
A kind word costs nothing and is remembered forever.
fate: I cannot know what will happen, so I choose to hope.
Life is too short to waste a single evening.
